client_review: Hippo in img-048 (and duplicate img-082) is the dressed blue-grey toy decided as hippo by 5 of 5 votes. It is the only usable hippo photo; please confirm it is a hippo and not another animal, and supply a clean shot of a plain hippo if one exists.
Hippo, rhino and zebra wall-mounted heads appear only in a collage whose panels are about 288 px wide. Please send the original full-size photos of these heads, they would be the best hero images.

Standing plush versus wall-mounted head: the client should say whether wall heads are a separate product or an option, since they are different forms. Wall heads are not in the catalogue yet (zebra head img-021 is kept only as a range image).
Rhino light blue shade varies with lighting across photos (light blue, grey-blue, slightly lavender in img-026). Please confirm all are one yarn colour or whether there is a separate grey-blue rhino.
Brown rhino with cream horns is seen only in market table photos (img-039, img-071, img-043). Please confirm it is a rhino and a regular colour, and send a clean photo.
Zebra has one colourway (black and white); yarn looks dark brown-black in img-037. Confirm label.
